adapters.label: Therapeutics Data Commons (TDC)
adapters.purpose: Offline ML eval / benchmarks against graded claims; not seed authority
adapters.notes: Codebase MIT; each dataset has its own license — review task page + provider terms before any download/run. Cite TDC + underlying sets.

adapters.label: AlphaFold3
adapters.notes: Source code Apache-2.0 (post-2026 relicense); model parameters remain under AlphaFold 3 Model Parameters Terms of Use — non-commercial / restricted. No commercial signed claim; never vendor weights into hsi-core.

adapters.label: Boltz
adapters.purpose: Open structure / complex (+ affinity) prediction alternative; discovery-only
adapters.notes: Upstream documents MIT for code and weights (academic + commercial). Still: no weight vendoring in hsi-core; proposals only; Boltz-2.1 closed API / third-party hosting has separate terms — re-check before those paths.

adapters.label: ESM (FAIR facebookresearch/esm)
adapters.purpose: Protein language embeddings / similarity helpers for discovery edges
adapters.notes: Scoped to archived FAIR ESM (MIT code + weights for ESM-2/ESMFold). P3.3 thin embedding stub → ModelProposalArtifacts + embedding sidecar refs (runtime stub|esm; import-only live path). EvolutionaryScale ESM-3 / ESMC use Cambrian Open / Non-Commercial terms — treat as a separate adapter/review; never clinic PHI sequences; never vendor multi-GB weights here.

adapters.label: OpenMM
adapters.purpose: Molecular dynamics simulation plugin (lab lane; not Gate C evidence)
adapters.notes: OpenMM license family (MIT/LGPL components historically) — research MD OK under documented terms; compute cost; simulation trajectories are not Gate C evidence alone.

adapters.label: RDKit
adapters.purpose: Cheminformatics descriptors / fingerprints for research claims
adapters.notes: BSD-style permissive toolkit. Descriptors never invent clinical edges; proposals only.

adapters.label: REINVENT4
adapters.purpose: Generative molecular design sandbox (ISI lab only)
adapters.notes: Apache-2.0 typical for REINVENT4. P3.2 thin spike → ModelProposalArtifacts only (runtime stub|reinvent; import-only live path). Never clinic recommendation path; never auto-promote generative designs into graded KG; no multi-GB weight vendoring.

adapters.label: ISI 12-agent research workbench
adapters.purpose: Supervised research agents (orchestrator + specialists) — runtime out of hsi-core
adapters.notes: Catalog/schema pattern only in hsi-core. Executable runtime = ISI product (out of repo). No agent runtime sign-off claimed here.

instructions: Read docs/P3_ADAPTER_RFC.md before wiring any adapter.
Refuse to run / download / vendor when blockedUntilSignOff=true.
Emit ModelProposalArtifact only → Gate C pending (autoApprove=false).
Never flip hsiGrade / curationReview; never autoApproveIntoKg.
Never vendor multi-GB model weights into hsi-core.
Never claim commercialLicenseSigned without written evidence in-repo.
signOffStatus vocabulary: not_signed | needs_review | non_commercial_only | research_ok_documented.
